summary: Trekor Metals Ltd (formerly Taseko Mines Limited) filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains routine financial results, including revenues of C$567.6 million for the six-month period, net income of C$39.1 million, and balance sheet items such as long-term debt of C$731.4 million and Florence financings. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, spin-off, restructuring, etc.) is announced. The filing is purely a periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
